servinfo.title: Electric Throttle Body Assembly Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Electric Throttle Body and Intake Manifold Components:K14D

attention4.ptxt: The electric throttle body will lose its original performance if it is disassembled.
Do not disassemble the electric throttle body.
If any faulty condition is found, replace the electric throttle body with a new one.

attention3.ptxt: After replacing electric throttle body assembly, calibration of throttle valve position is required.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect connector (2) from boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.
Remove intercooler outlet hose No.2 (4) from intercooler outlet pipe (5).
Remove heater hose clamp bracket bolt (1) and hose clamp bolt (2).
Remove intercooler outlet pipe (3) from electric throttle body.
Disconnect connector (1) from electric throttle body assembly (2).
Remove electric throttle body from intake manifold assembly.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Clean mating surfaces and install new electric throttle body gasket (1) to intake manifold.
Tighten electric throttle body assembly bolts to specified torque.
Connect connector to electric throttle body assembly securely.
